title: CampaignIntelligenceBrief
description: The CIB — the single artifact the Research War Room Synthesizer produces and every downstream plane consumes (GROWTH-OS-BUILD-SPEC §9.3 NORMATIVE, Appendix B). Canonical field names; every claim carries evidence + confidence; versioned & diffable; FROZEN-AFTER-MERGE (a new field ⇒ version bump per §6.2 extend-never-mutate). The strategy-compiler turns this into a MediaPlan (media_plan.schema.json); the vendor sees a human-readable render with 'challenge this' buttons (re-run a single agent).

cib_id.description: Unique id of this CIB version (UUID).

version.description: Schema version of the CIB shape (frozen-after-merge; §9.3). Distinct from the per-tenant content revision (see revision).

revision.description: Monotonic content revision for THIS campaign request's CIB, so successive war-room runs / single-agent re-runs ('challenge this') are diffable.

campaign_request_ref.description: Reference to the originating campaign.requested event/record this brief answers.

generated_at.description: When the Synthesizer produced this CIB.

industry_pack_ref.description: Id+version of the industry pack (§18) that seeded persona/offer/compliance/KPI defaults.

business.description: BusinessUnderstanding agent output (§9.2): the vendor's offer landscape and constraints.

offer_map.description: The vendor's products/services and what each sells.

price.description: Price in INR paise (integer) where known.

margins.description: Gross margin info (optional; drives margin-aware target_CPqL §13.4). When absent, defaults come from the industry pack AND it is said so.

gross_margin_per_sale.description: Gross margin per sale in INR paise (integer).

constraints.description: Hard constraints (geography, capacity, exclusions, service areas, do-not-target).

proof_assets.description: Available proof (reviews, ratings, case studies, certifications, awards) the creatives can use.

seasonality.description: Demand seasonality notes incl India festival windows (§I12 festival radar).

offer.description: OfferStrategist output (§9.2): the chosen offer plus alternates (offers are first-class experiment arms §I8).

personas.description: PersonaBuilder output (§9.2): the audiences to address.

language_register.description: How this persona talks (formal/casual/code-mixed) — guides copy register.

locale.description: Primary locale of the persona (BCP-47-ish), §I13 vernacular.

angles.description: The persuasion angles (§9.3). Each carries hooks, objection counters and locales; angle ids are referenced by the diversity_matrix and by CreativeDNA.angle_ref for attribute-level learning.

pain.description: The pain this angle leads with.

proof.description: The proof that backs the promise (ties to business.proof_assets).

hooks.description: Opening hooks for this angle. §9.3 calls for 5.

locales.description: Locales this angle is authored/transcreated for.

diversity_matrix.description: CreativeIntel output (§9.2/§9.3): the matrix that forces GENUINE diversity (Moat #2) so creatives don't collapse into one Entity-ID cluster. Seeds the creative batch; min_distinct_concepts ≥ 8 (§9.3).

angles.description: Angle ids (from angles[].id) in play for this batch.

formats.description: Creative formats to span (must align with creative_dna.format vocab).

visual_treatments.description: Visual treatments to span (must align with creative_dna.visual_treatment vocab).

hook_types.description: Hook types to span (align with creative_dna.hook_type vocab).

headline_frameworks.description: Copy frameworks to span (align with creative_dna.copy_framework vocab).

min_distinct_concepts.description: Minimum number of genuinely distinct concepts the batch must contain (§9.3 default 8; QA blocks launch sets below this, §15.4).

gene_mix.description: Memory→behavior seeding policy (§14.2): proportion proven vs novel vs wildcard genes.

channel_plan.description: Where the campaign runs and to what objective/destination, with a split (§9.3).

objective.description: Campaign objective. Meta 2026: use Sales/Leads where Advantage+ defaults (§10.1); never optimize 'conversation started' (§23).

destination.description: Where the click/tap lands. CTWA opens a FREE 72h WhatsApp window (§10.1, §11.2).

split.description: Fraction of budget/effort allocated to this channel (0–1; channel_plan splits should sum to ~1).

budget_plan.description: BudgetStrategist output (§9.3): test/scale envelope in INR. Amounts in INR paise (integer) per the money model. References kill/scale rules and approval thresholds rather than inlining the rule logic.

test_daily.description: Recommended daily test budget, INR paise (integer).

max_daily.description: Hard daily ceiling, INR paise (integer). The Budget Governor enforces it (§13).

min_viable_test.description: War-Game minimum daily budget to produce a meaningful answer (§13.4/§14.5), INR paise (integer). If the vendor's budget < this, the compiler returns insufficient_budget rather than silently launching untestable (§10.1).

kill_rules_ref.description: Id/version of the kill-rule pack (guardrails G1–G6, §12.3) in policy-config.

scale_rules_ref.description: Id/version of the scale-rule pack (promote, §12.4) in policy-config.

approval_thresholds.description: Per-action-class approval thresholds for this campaign (§17), referenced by ActionPlans.

followup_plan.description: The post-click engagement plan (the journey IS the signal factory, §16.3). Optional in CIB-lite (Phase 1).

wa_journey_id.description: Id of the follow-up WhatsApp journey (journeys DSL, §16.3) to trigger on lead.captured.

voice_qualify.description: Whether to trigger an AI voice qualification call on hot leads (§16.2).

sla_seconds.description: Speed-to-lead SLA: max seconds from capture to first contact (hot lead → call ≤60s, §16.2).

kpi.description: The success definition. North star is CPqL (§8.5), with a margin-derived target (§13.4).

north_star.description: The single metric the campaign optimizes toward (§8.5 NORTH STAR = CPqL).

target_CPqL.description: Target cost per qualified lead, INR paise (integer). Derived margin×close_rate×safety (§13.4).

derivation.description: How target_CPqL was derived (margin×close_rate per §13.4), incl whether margin was vendor-stated or pack-default.

measurement.description: How the loop is measured: which events map to the optimization ladder, the UTM scheme, and the CAPI value source (§9.3, §11).

events_map.description: Per-tenant mapping of business outcomes → optimization-ladder events (§11.1: Lead/QualifiedLead/Schedule/Attended/Purchase).

capi_value_source.description: What value is sent on the Lead CAPI event — the moat (§11.1: value = lead_score as predicted-value proxy; true value on Purchase).

compliance.description: ComplianceScout verdict (§9.2/§10.9): category risk + whether human review is required + required disclosures (e.g. RERA for real-estate, health/finance limits).

special_ad_category.description: Meta special ad category if applicable (credit/employment/housing/social-issues), which restricts targeting.

requires_review.description: Whether a human compliance review is required before launch.

evidence.description: The grounding for the brief: EVERY material claim carries a source + confidence (§9.3 rule). This is what powers the 'challenge this' UX and keeps the war room honest.

claim.description: The asserted fact (e.g. 'competitor X runs question-hook ads 90+ days').

source.description: Provenance: which agent/tool produced it (web.search, meta.ad_library, warehouse.query, memory.read, benchmarks.read, etc.) plus a URL/ref where applicable.

agent.description: Which war-room agent surfaced this claim (§9.2 roster), for single-agent re-run.

memories_cited.description: Learning-memory entries this CIB used (§14.1: 'Every CIB cites memories used'). Enables negative-memory checks (don't re-propose what failed) and counterfactual replay.

plan.description: Payment plan / EMI framing (relevant for India high-ticket).
